import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { buildApp } from '../../src/app.js';
import { env } from '../../src/config/env.js';
import { testAuthAdapter } from './auth.js';

// Installed over the generated database-backed test helper by verify.mjs.
const createTestApp = async () => {
  const app = await buildApp({ mongoUri: `mongodb://test-double/${randomUUID()}`, auth: testAuthAdapter });
  await app.ready();
  return { app, url: (path: string) => `${env.API_PREFIX}${path}`, close: () => app.close() };
};
type TTestApp = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createTestApp>>;
export { createTestApp };
export type { TTestApp };
